description: This file defines the RateLimiter class used for managing rate limiting logic within the AWS SDK for PHP, including token bucket management and cubic throttle calculations.
external_files: php standard library functions (e.g., usleep, microtime)

classes.name: RateLimiter
classes.description: A class implementing rate limiting with token bucket and cubic throttle algorithms for AWS SDK PHP.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RateLimiter with optional configuration parameters.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the rate limiter is enabled.

methods.name: getSendToken
methods.description: Requests a token to send a request, acquiring one via internal logic.

methods.name: updateSendingRate
methods.description: Updates the sending rate based on whether throttling occurred.

methods.name: acquireToken
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a token for sending, refilling the token bucket as needed.

methods.name: calculateTimeWindow
methods.description: Calculates the time window for cubic throttle adjustments.

methods.name: cubicSuccess
methods.description: Calculates the new rate after a successful request using cubic function.

methods.name: cubicThrottle
methods.description: Calculates throttled rate based on cubic function.

methods.name: refillTokenBucket
methods.description: Refills the token bucket based on elapsed time.

methods.name: time
methods.description: Returns current time, using a custom provider if set, otherwise microtime.

methods.name: updateMeasuredRate
methods.description: Updates the measured transaction rate based on recent request counts.

methods.name: updateTokenBucketRate
methods.description: Updates the token bucket parameters based on new rate.
